'''Wan Zhexian''' ({{zh|s=万哲先}}; 7 November 1927 – 30 May 2023) was a Chinese mathematician, an academician of the [[Chinese Academy of Sciences]].

==Biography==
Wan was born in Zichuan (now [[Zichuan District]] of [[Zibo]]), [[Shandong]], on 7 November 1927, while his [[Ancestral home (Chinese)|ancestral home]] is in [[Xiantao]], [[Hubei]].<ref name="bee">{{cite news |author1=Sun Zonghe ({{lang|zh|孙宗鹤}}) |url=https://tech.gmw.cn/2023-06/06/content_36611615.htm |script-title=zh:万哲先院士在京逝世 享年95岁 |work=gmw.cn |date=6 June 2023 |access-date=29 June 2023 |language=zh}}</ref> He attended Zhangdian Primary School ({{zh|s=张店小学|labels=no}}).<ref>{{cite news |author1=Cao Jing ({{lang|zh|曹竞}}) |url=https://news.cyol.com/gb/articles/2023-06/02/content_lbjpL9TWAQ.html |script-title=zh:沉痛悼念！我们的“校友”万哲先院士 |work=cyol.com |date=2 June 2023 |access-date=29 June 2023 |language=zh}}</ref>

Wan was admitted to the Mathematics Department of [[National South-West Associated University]] in 1944.<ref name="bee"/> He graduated from [[Tsinghua University]] in 1948 and taught there after graduation.<ref name="bee"/> In 1950, he was transferred to the Institute of Systems science, Chinese Academy of Sciences, where he successively worked as an assistant, assistant researcher, associate researcher, and researcher.<ref name="bee"/> In the same year, he studied [[classical group]] under the guidance of Professor [[Hua Luogeng]], and co-wrote "Classical Group" with Hua Luogeng in 1963.<ref>{{cite news |url=http://sourcedb.amss.cas.cn/zw/zjrck/200907/t20090713_2065596.html |script-title=zh:万哲先 |work=amss.cas.cn |date=30 May 2023 |access-date=29 June 2023 |language=zh}}</ref>

Wan joined the [[China Association for Promoting Democracy]] in 1953 and the [[Chinese Communist Party]] in 1985.<ref name="bee"/>

On 30 May 2023, he died of an illness in [[Beijing]], aged 95.<ref name="bee"/>

==Honours and awards==
* 1987 State Natural Science Award (Third Class) for the isomorphism theory of Classical Group
* 1991 Member of the [[Chinese Academy of Sciences]] (CAS)
* 1995 2nd Hua Luogeng Mathematics Prize
